szenen.vo: [intense] Somewhere in the future, there's a version of you looking back at this moment.
[intense] Five years from now, you'll either thank yourself, or wish you had started today.
[intense] Two futures. One full of regret. One you're proud of.
[intense] Every small choice you make today decides which one you get.
[shouting] So make future you proud, starting today!
[intense] Nobody else can do it for you.
[shouting] Become the person future you will thank!
